column7: revoke_failed half of dynamic-secret-kill-switch-revert-002 (#2698, code fix #2825): a RevokeLease whose target drop FAILED, landing between RenewLease's read and its write, must keep the lease revoke_failed with its revoke_error and its ORIGINAL expires_at, so the sweep retries the still-live credential at the original expiry (asserted via ListExpiredActiveLeases), and the renewal fails. RenewLease writes expires_at only through ExtendDynamicSecretLeaseExpiry (status='active' CAS). Replica B runs on its own connection, inside A's engine.Renew. SQLite twin: TestCTAReview_RenewLease_vs_RevokeFailed_SQLite (default-ci). Red proof not expressible with redproof.sh (the fixture postdates the fix); see SESSION-LEASE-SHARE-RACE-1.
